original_plan_requirement: NVIDIA 数据中心：Ampere A100/A800、Hopper H100/H200/H20、Blackwell B200/B300 与 GB 系列、Vera Rubin；SXM/PCIe/NVL/机柜分别固定型号与供电配置。
acceptance_reason: All originally named families and the explicitly enumerated forms reviewed in H01 rounds 1–3 have separate official-source-backed records. Missing numerical evidence is retained as unknown and identified by reviewed source rather than fabricated. This accepts the source-review work package, not a claim that every physical specification, selectable precision or every future/additional NVIDIA SKU is known.
scope_boundary: 25 H01 records; the other 7 NVIDIA records belong to H02. Binding covers all 32 NVIDIA records so changes to either subset invalidate this snapshot. Per-peak instruction/accumulator/clock normalization remains H05; archive/version machinery remains H07. No original named family is removed.

device_subset.normalization: Sort devices by id; serialize full selected device records with json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon)); UTF-8; array order inside each device preserved.

family_coverage.forms_reviewed: 40 GB PCIe / SXM4; 80 GB PCIe / SXM; separate HGX CTS 500 W power configuration.
family_coverage.evidence_and_remaining_boundary: Official product page, Ampere architecture, 40 GB product brief and datasheet checked. 40 GB Boost 1410 MHz normalized; 80 GB clock-to-exact-power-bin normalization remains H05 work. Rounded 1.6 TB/s is not substituted for 1555 GB/s; CTS 500 W does not imply a new measured peak.

family_coverage.forms_reviewed: 40 GB Active; ordinary 40 GB PCIe; 80 GB PCIe, liquid PCIe and HGX identities.
family_coverage.evidence_and_remaining_boundary: Active product/specification pages provide capacity, bandwidth, power and limited typed peaks. AI Enterprise 5.0 Appendix A identifies ordinary physical products but does not provide their bandwidth, precision peaks, clock or power. Current official-domain searches have not located a readable full per-SKU datasheet; this is a checked-source gap, not proof NVIDIA never published one.

family_coverage.forms_reviewed: 80 GB SXM; 80 GB PCIe; 94 GB NVL per GPU.
family_coverage.evidence_and_remaining_boundary: Product page and Hopper whitepaper provide selected capacity, bandwidth, power and precision rows; NVL 188 GB pair is not assigned to one GPU. Whitepaper clock rows have been read but not normalized for every current catalog profile; this is implementation/mapping work in H05, not an undisclosed clock claim.

family_coverage.forms_reviewed: 141 GB SXM and 141 GB NVL per GPU.
family_coverage.evidence_and_remaining_boundary: Official specification table checked for both forms, power and sparsity footnote. Exact per-profile clock and all accumulator mappings are not supplied by that product table; broader ISA mapping remains H05 and is not declared fully searched.

family_coverage.forms_reviewed: SXM5 96 GB and SXM5 141 GB physical products.
family_coverage.evidence_and_remaining_boundary: AI Enterprise release 7 Hopper reference identifies both products. Its vGPU framebuffer and MIG profiles cannot establish physical bandwidth or peak rates. Additional official-domain searches did not locate a readable full product specification table. Bandwidth, power, precision throughput and clock remain unknown; no third-party fill.

family_coverage.forms_reviewed: Single B200 SXM6, 180 GB, configurable up to 1000 W.
family_coverage.evidence_and_remaining_boundary: HGX component table/Blackwell brief and B200 PCF checked. PCF explicitly supplies per-GPU power and SXM6; its inconsistent FP32 unit/aggregate bandwidth are not imported. Architecture maximum 1200 W is not substituted for this B200 configuration; exact clock is not established.

HGX component table and DGX B300 guide checked. Guide specifies eight GPUs and whole-system power, not a per-GPU TDP. Blackwell Ultra architecture up-to-1400-W maximum is not sufficient to bind this selected B300 SKU. Exact power, clock and module-generation suffix remain unknown.

Official product table and Blackwell technical brief checked. GPU-only memory, GPU count, sparse/dense footnotes and separate units retained. CPU memory excluded; aggregate memory is not a contiguous single-GPU pool. Platform power/clock are not established in selected specification rows.

NVL72 product table and Ultra architecture checked. Direct Superchip section gives two GPUs, 30 PFLOPS dense / 40 PFLOPS sparse NVFP4 and 1 TB combined HBM3E+LPDDR5X. GPU-only capacity/bandwidth cannot be isolated from that combined number; architecture maximum 288 GB per GPU is not an exact Superchip bin. Rack uses the locked US 20 TB profile, not a mixture of regional versions.

family_coverage.forms_reviewed: Single Rubin GPU from NVL72 product table, separately US 19.2 TB/s and UK preliminary 22 TB/s profiles.
family_coverage.evidence_and_remaining_boundary: US/UK product tables and architecture materials checked. Distinct bandwidth, NVLink and precision footnotes retained; neither profile overwrites the other. Product-table native FP64 is separate from Tensor Core DGEMM emulation. Power/clock are absent from selected rows. This records GPU columns within NVL72, not a fictitious measured full-rack result.

checked_source_numeric_gaps.search_boundary: Official product/documentation searches plus locked AI Enterprise identity references; no exhaustive-publication or never-disclosed claim.

excluded_inferences: Blackwell Ultra maximum 1400 W assigned to B300

conflicts_and_exclusions.resolution: Separate 19.2 TB/s and 22 TB/s records; preliminary UK values and footnotes remain local to UK profile.
Use 1555 GB/s product/architecture evidence, retain rounded datasheet 1.6 TB/s only as corroboration.
Use its explicit single-GPU power and form only; other performance fields use independent HGX/technical sources.
Current record uses locked US 20 TB and its associated precision rows; regional variants are not silently blended or treated as measured upgrades.
